notes.title: Key Binding Patch - v1.0.09
notes.notes:
We are aware that the key binding menu wasn't in the best form on the v1.0 release. Hopefully, this patch will fix most of the issues - thank you for your patience and reports!

[h2]Key Binding Menu Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Binding a key that's already in use will swap it with the current one
[*]You can now remove the binding by pressing DELETE
[*]Fixed wrong Gamepad button glyphs for Attack / Alt Attack
[*]Added missing Gamepad glyphs for Spells
[*]Renamed "Run" action to "Walk" action to avoid confusion since running is on by default
[*][b]Gamepad controls couldn't (and still can't) be changed[/b], but the system allowed binding gamepad buttons, which trigger double-controller bind issues. As a result, we now filter out gamepad button prompts when assigning a new key to avoid confusion.
[*]Fixed some other minor issues regarding the keybinding.
[/list]
 If you continue to experience issues with the key bindings after this update, please let us know. 

[h2]Level Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*]Passages can now be disabled with Deactivator
[*]Background Setter editor object text changed from "Music Setter" to "BCG Setter"
[*]Another tip added to the normal mode ([i]Shift + Click to disconnect objects[/i])
[/list]

[b]Challenges:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Have at least two secret areas[/p][/*][*][p]Add at least two Spell Shrines[/p][/*][*][p]Include one puzzle [/p][/*][*][p]Include a Seer's Orb and Magic Floor ([i]secret?[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Create one scripted sequence ([i]moving walls, breaking walls, earthquake...[/i])[/p][/*][*][p](Harder) Create and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmod.io%2Fg%2Fwizordum%2Fr%2Fcustom-sprites"]use custom sprite[/url] or [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmod.io%2Fg%2Fwizordum%2Fr%2Fcustom-tileset"]custom textures[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The theme is pretty abstract - sacred place, a sanctum, can be anything, from a small shrine, to a ruined cathedral or unholy lava temple. notes.title: The most hated Sewers level - Reforged
notes.notes:
Since the early access launch of Wizordum, Murky Wastes, the infamous sewers level, has received many negative opinions. Being the 3rd level in the game, the level was very long, and the difficulty spike was quite big. Not to mention tedious backtracking and many switches - we just wanted to stay true to the tradition of sewer levels. However, it didn't turn out as we hoped it would.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/e9314b0ef4fda173efbb555236f38f33bb514ea7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/920251c13ff803a876400181a06ca70335f443ee.png[/img]

Because of that, we decided to go back to the Murky Wastes and flip some things around to get rid of most of the backtracking and to make the whole level slightly more linear, so it's harder to get lost now. As a result of this, we have a shorter and more enjoyable level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/e21fcdb6b6d7d6ada48f1a7264440ec0fb34eadc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/1d675905b999cbb7a90b8aa6287f42f44591e3d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/4e1855755fc59616cff166be8b1ba5028bc23d6a.png[/img]

Hopefully, this will make the overall experience better for everyone! And if you loved the old vanilla Murky Wastes, don't fret. We will upload it as a custom map soon so you can experience the original map whenever you want.

[h3]Storm Gauntlets - Chain of Lightning Alternative Attack[/h3]
If you have purchased the Storm Gauntlets upgrade at the shop, you can now use the alternative attack, connecting up to five enemies with a Chain of Lightning, dealing 20 damage per enemy in the chain.

[b]Enjoy the new update, and let us know how you like the new Murky Wastes, Mage![/b] 🧙‍♂️

[b]Storm Gauntlets[/b] - Use the gloves to master the energy of the Storm to caused quick and deadly damage to your enemies.

[h3]Weapon Upgrades[/h3]

[h3]New Spell System[/h3]

[i]NOTE: Some spells were moved from consumables to the new Spell System (Repulsion, Hellfire, Wizard's Wrath).[/i]

Consumables that moved to the Spell System were replaced with new Consumable Scrolls like Frost Breath, Blink, and Arcane Shield. Other additions, like Haste Potion, will make you move faster for a short duration.

[h3]New Episode[/h3]
Like the first episode, Episode 2 features 7 levels besides the bonus level. The secret level is also in development. 

Please note that we had some unforeseen delays, so we had to ship this update without the final boss of Episode 2, but we will release an update soon after this update to conclude the story of this chapter.

notes.title: Wizordum Roadmap
notes.notes:
First of all, I would like to thank everyone for playing the game! We are thrilled to see the game standing at the [b]Very Positive[/b] rating, and we appreciate every bit of the feedback we received from you so far!

We have said this many times, but we are reading your feedback on all possible channels. This roadmap might not show every little detail we have in store for you, but we'll keep doing more of what you love and making some drastic but positive changes to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/8bbc29a4b5fd00c9be4863440148de4d5950bc2f.png[/img]

I'm sure you have questions after going over this Roadmap, so I will go ahead and add some clarifications.

[h3]New Spell System[/h3]
We watched a lot of streams and videos of Wizordum, and we've noticed that most players don't even use consumable items and spells. Lots of feedback was given about this issue as well. 
Because of that, we will introduce a Spell System that will make using spells more practical and fun. We will still have consumables, but they will be used for Potions, Torches, and other items. We will talk more about the system in the near future.

[h3] Merchant & Coins[/h3]
Treasure in Wizordum was always meant for bonus points only so that you could climb up the online leaderboards. However, it turns out most of you would prefer to have a store in the game where you could exchange that treasure for something more practical. With this system, you will be able to spend your coins to upgrade your Spells and weapons and buy a few other things. Rest assured, score hunters, the classic score hunting, will stay as well. 

[h3]Alternative attacks for all Weapons[/h3]
Lots of you asked for alternative attacks to make weapons even more fun, and we're going to do just that. So far, only the Frostweaver has the alternative attack, and we are releasing an update soon with the Mace's alternative attack, but are already planning some great alternatives for the rest. 

[h3]New Playable Character[/h3]
With the new Spell System in place, we would like to introduce additional playable characters as well with a different spell arsenal, stats, and possibly even some weapons so you can re-play the game in a different way.


[h3]Last Update Before the Next Big Content Update[/h3]
We want to stabilize the game with one final update so we can focus 100% on the next big update - Episode 2. There's a lot to do, and we would like to keep the focus there.


[h2]What about other stuff?[/h2]
There are other minor and more significant changes we are planning to do over the course of the Early Access or for the v1.0. Here are some of them without a specific date or order. 
[list]
[*] Changing the Sewers level from Episode 1 to make it more fun
[*] Possibly splitting the City of Ember from Episode 1 into two maps while adding something extra to both.
[*] Rebalancing levels (adjusting pickups, enemies, etc.)
[*] Adding Collectible Lore Scrolls to the levels, which will reveal bits of the story
[*] Updating the AI to make enemy encounters more fun
[*] Additional input support (e.g., consumable / weapon selection wheel)
[*] Map Editor improvements
[*] Animated Story Screens
[/list]

Please remember that everything can change slightly, from features to dates, but this is the active plan we are following. That also means that any new feedback is still very valuable.

I hope you like what you're seeing on the Roadmap. Is there anything specific you are incredibly excited about? Let us know!

For this update, we mainly focused on the Secret Level, optimizations, and the new Save Game system, so we didn't pay much attention to the rest and only fixed what we could in the given time. Please note that all bug reports are noted and put on our to-do list. Rest assured, we will get to them!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
One week has passed since we launched our first public demo, and the response we have received so far is astounding! It is nice to see many players enjoying the game, even if it's just a small demo, which means we are doing something right, and we'll keep doing what we do.

Although the feedback was overall very positive, you also reported some issues you were having with the game, so we tried to address most of them in this patch.

[h2]Updates ːCotcTorchː[/h2] 
[list]
[*] FOV slider added
[*] Hitboxes and projectiles improved ([i]you will hardly miss now with your weapons, and rats are much less of an annoyance[/i])
[*] Mouse sensitivity slider values adjusted
[*] Default game settings updated 
[*] You can now switch weapons with a Scroll Wheel
[*] Invisibility cloak duration increased from 10s to 15s
[*] Bronze key visuals updated, so they look less like a gold key 
[*] More loot added to the barrels in both demo levels
[*] You can now destroy grain sacks ([i]yes, those are grain sacks and not gold bags[/i])
[*] Pillars have better collision
[*] [b]Gamepad controls[/b] improved which makes game playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b] as well
- Switching weapons with bumpers
- Navigating consumables with D-PAD (left, right) and consuming them (up).
- Interactions (South button)
- Attack (triggers / west button)
- Map (north button)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes ːCotcShovelː[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Pressing ALT+TAB won't disable strafing anymore when returning to the game
[*] Music is now looping properly
[*] Goblin Berserk stray pixel removed from death animation
[*] Weapon switching broken if you opened a map while firing
[*] Cinematic black bars now work correctly on all resolutions
[*] Invisibility effect won't stuck if you finish a level while under the effect
[*] If you enter the passage (transition) while the pickup effect is in progress, the pickup glow effect won't be stuck.
[/list]

With all these changes, the demo should be much more enjoyable, all thanks to your feedback! There are other things that we will be updating and fixing, but it will take a bit longer. 

We read and appreciate all the feedback we get, even if we don't reply to you immediately. If you are new here, feel free to leave your feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1715590/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/Gc7Kgp3]Discord[/url] or send it directly to our [url=wizordum@emberheartgames.com]email[/url].

Wizordum is [url=https://www.patreon.com/wizordum]100% funded by Patreon[/url], so if you would like to support the game further, this is something you can consider. Every little bit helps! ːcc_candleː

Thank you for your support, enjoy the game! 🧙‍♂️
